posts.author: tlbearer
posts.body:
Resource Type:
Enemies/SV_Enemies
Maker Format:
MZ
Makers I Own:
MZ
Art Style:
So right now I'm using the old VX Ace Style for the Spirits and I have the following DLCs:
Enemies: MV Trinity Resource Pack, RPG MakerFES_RES, and Yokai Parade
Tilesets: FSM (all), Winlu (all but the cyber/futuristic stuff), and KR (I have 7 or 8 of these so just ask)
Description:
My game is about the fact that the main character can feel that the world is slowly dying because Agents of Chaos are trying their best to corrupt each of the Spirits of Nature. The Spirit of Light, Lumina, reaches out to send the main character on a quest to stop these Agents of Chaos. If you want to read more about the game, please feel free to here:
https://tlbeare7.wixsite.com/alternatefantasygame/saving-gaia
In short, what I'm looking for is Enemies/SV_Enemies of these Agents of Chaos that the player is going to have to deal with. They should look like twisted versions of the Spirits of Nature, or Nature itself. There 5 Spirits before getting to Lumina, Mother of the Spirits and Spirit of Light itself, and then finally Chaos, Spirit of Darkness.
The others are as follows:
Aero, Spirit of Wind
Terra, Spirit of Earth
Udine, Spirit of Water
Cyna, Spirit of Fire
Shiva, Spirit of Ice
Each of these would need some twisted form of the element of nature that they represent. I would eventually like one for Lumina as well, but I think it will be a while before that is needed.

posts.author: Avery
posts.body:
Wild take, but since you don't work with RMVX Ace, why not "cast" new characters for these if you don't seem to need static battlers anyways? There are plenty of resources out there, including generator resources. This is what I quickly whipped up e.g. with I think just default stuff (and I think mostly default gradients? There you can add extra ones with ease for even more variation!):
You can do A LOT more if you look for existing free parts and add your own gradients.
Making new gradients for the generator
Sometimes the default Generator colors just don’t do it, but it can be difficult to recolor the graphics after building them, especially since you need to select just the right area on the face image. Better you just have the perfect gradient at hand, right?  If you go to your generator folder...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
There are also existing gradients out there, just for example:
【MZ】[キャラクター生成]デフォルトの髪色の濃淡パターンを増やしたい！素材
ツクールMZ公式のキャラクター生成(generator)ツール用 髪の色の公式デフォルト素材の改変・追加用の色グラデーション(grad_hair)素材です。 服の色や目の色や顔の色の関連素材はこちらになります 【MZ】[キャラクター生成]デフォルトの服色の濃淡パターンを増やしたい！素材 https://tm.yu…
tm.yumineko.com
Category: Generator
For Commercial and Non-Commercial Use. Strictly for RPG Maker Engine use only. Please read the complete  Terms of Use .
dainiri-art.weebly.com
Edit: I think I got confused and thought you were looking for SV battlers of said spirits. It took me multiple re-readings and now I think you look of evil versions of the Ace Elementals?
Then I'd just use the VX versions of them (maybe get it on the next sale?). They look very similar, but have an overall darker and more "non-human" look to it.
You can also look for other artists who rendered their own imagination of those spirits for even another twist.
Lud Sakura has at least the goddess:
